edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook): matchup-defining — His only real engage — dodge it and the lane is free. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Prismatic Barrier banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Dredge Line (Q) is 14s at rank 1, down to 10s at max — his only real engage; dodge it and the lane is free until it's back. Depth Charge (R) is 120/100/80s and chases, so body-block it for your carry rather than trading Flash.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: His hook is 14s at rank 1, 10s at max — hold your Q until it's down, then root him risk-free.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Don't hold W (Barrier) waiting on the hook — cast it early on the CC chain, not after Depth Charge lands.
